description: This file implements the registration page model for user sign-up within ASP.NET Core Razor Pages framework. It handles user input validation, user creation, email confirmation, and sign-in logic.

classes.name: RegisterModel
classes.description: Page model for user registration, managing user creation, email confirmation, and sign-in process.

classes.name: RegisterModel.InputModel
classes.description: Data transfer object for capturing user registration inputs including email, password, and password confirmation.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests, initializes return URL.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Handles POST requests to register a new user, including validation, user creation, email confirmation, and login.
